name: Pixlr
tagline: Pixlr is a browser-based photo editor that offers AI-powered tools including background removal, object eraser, generative fill, and automatic retouching alongside a full suite of traditional editing controls. Its two modes — Pixlr X for quick edits and Pixlr E for advanced work — cater to casual users and designers who need power without installing software. It's one of the most widely used free online photo editors globally.
